'''Lorrad''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban world]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster's]] [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]]. By around [[25,130 BBY]], it was ruled by the [[Livien League]] and was the site of a League [[Battle of Lorrad|victory]] over the forces of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. Lorrad later spent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Kingdom of Barseg]], only gaining its freedom around [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]].

==Description==
Lorrad was a grimy [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|urban world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Lorrad system/Legends|Lorrad system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Barseg system/Legends|Barseg system]] as well as the [[Desev system]] of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Xim" /> Lorrad shared its name with the company [[Lorrad Flightworks]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:LorradBattle-TheHistoryOfXimAndTheTionCluster.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lorrad was the site of a Livien League victory over the Kingdom of Cron.]]
Between approximately [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], Lorrad was part of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] people's state known as the [[Livien League]]. During that time, it was the site of a [[Battle of Lorrad|space battle]] where the League's forces defeated those of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], thus temporarily halting its [[Xer's Campaigns|expansion]] under [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xer VIII]]. At some point after the League was incorporated into the territory of the [[Cronese]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], Xer's [[Gender/Legends|son]] who had ascended to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]<ref name="Xim" /> in 25,130 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Lorrad was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by<ref name="Xim" /> the [[Kingdom of Barseg]],<ref name="Xim" /><ref name="Word" /> a state centered on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Barseg]]. Lorrad's servitude lasted for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], and the world only gained its freedom from Barseg after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] limited the latter's [[Politics/Legends|political]] influence around [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]].<ref name="Xim" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Lorrad was one of the major worlds of the Allied Tion sector.<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Lorrad was inhabited by the group known as the [[Lorradian]]s, many of whom lived in terrible conditions while their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was enslaved by the Kingdom of Barseg. After Lorrad became free from Barseg's rule, it remained economically oppressed, however.<ref name="Xim" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lorrad was introduced in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure authored by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]].<ref name="Lianna" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]], [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] placed it in grid square S-6.<ref name="Xim" />
